svg.title: The wing, water and current must work together
svg.desc: Qualitative plan view. Wing drive acts forward, hull resistance acts backward, wing side force is opposed by the underwater appendages. Below, ballast counters wing heeling moment. Ground velocity is water-relative boat velocity plus current.

g.text: Plan view; bow to the right. Qualitative forces, not to scale.
The wing, water and current must work together
Also balance roll: wing heeling moment ↔ ballast / buoyancy restoring moment
Ground velocity = water-relative velocity + current velocity
Mission progress is its component along the route.
